_README: Candidate research file for baliforamericans, produced 2026-10-13. Official sources were searched and opened for consequential claims where available. Verified records identify their source and checking date in notes; source interpretation, scope and unresolved details remain explicit. This file is not a substitute for checking official requirements immediately before travel. Volatile prices and exchange rates are not stored.

_fact_field_shape: Every FACT uses value, source_url, status and notes where available. Verification metadata is recorded in notes because the supplied schema does not define separate checked_at, review_after or source_kind properties.

power_plug_voltage.value: 230 V, 50 Hz; commonly type C and type F plugs. Verify appliance compatibility and bring an appropriate adapter.

visa._note: For ordinary US passport holders visiting for tourism, Indonesia's official Ngurah Rai Immigration office lists US citizens among eligible Visa on Arrival nationalities. Its published fee is IDR 500000 and the initial stay is 30 days, extendable once. Confirm current eligibility, entry purpose and extension rules on the official portal before travel.

by_nationality.passport: United States ordinary passport; short-stay tourism; Bali entry; rules checked 2026-10-13

type.value: visa_on_arrival; e-VOA is the online alternative where currently offered. Neither should be described as visa-free.
type.notes: Source kind: official Indonesian Immigration office. Opened 2026-10-13. The official page lists Amerika Serikat and says VOA costs IDR 500000, permits 30 days and can be extended once. Review after 2026-11-13. Check the official eVisa portal for the current electronic application flow.

max_stay_days.value: 30 initially; one extension is listed by Immigration. Confirm the extension's current permitted duration and process before relying on a longer stay.
max_stay_days.notes: Official immigration page opened 2026-10-13. Do not confuse initial authorized stay with a possible extension.

fee.value: IDR 500000 for VOA; approximately USD 30 only when supported by a dated exchange-rate calculation. The official fee is in IDR.
fee.notes: Official Immigration source opened 2026-10-13. Review after 2026-11-13. Other payment, bank or card charges may differ.

processing_time.notes: No reliable processing-time commitment verified. Do not promise immediate approval or a guaranteed processing duration.

online_authorization_required.value: The All Indonesia arrival declaration is required for international arrivals under the published Immigration guidance. This is separate from the visa. An e-VOA is an optional online method of obtaining the applicable visa, not a separate visa exemption.
online_authorization_required.notes: Official Immigration FAQ says international passengers must submit the arrival declaration through All Indonesia from 1 October 2025. Opened/search checked 2026-10-13. Review after 2026-11-13. Verify any subsequent policy changes.

official_application_url.notes: Official Indonesian Immigration eVisa portal. Use the government domain rather than paid third-party intermediaries. Confirm the appropriate visa subtype for the travel purpose.

value.why: Some charge service fees above the government visa fee or imitate official application pages. A third-party fee does not establish government endorsement.

value.name_or_type: Unofficial Bali tourist levy payment websites
value.why: Use the provincial Love Bali system and confirm the domain before entering passport or payment details.
Use the official All Indonesia platform; distinguish an arrival declaration from a visa application.

passport_validity_required.value: At least six months of validity from entry is the published Indonesian VOA requirement. A damaged passport or insufficient blank pages can cause problems; the US State Department page also specifies two blank pages for entry.
passport_validity_required.notes: US State Department Indonesia advisory opened 2026-10-13; advisory issued 2026-07-07. Indonesian Immigration guidance should also be checked directly before departure. Review after 2026-11-13.

onward_ticket_required.value: A confirmed return or onward ticket may be requested by the airline or Indonesian Immigration. Travelers should have one before departure.
onward_ticket_required.notes: Confirm against current visa conditions and airline requirements for the exact itinerary.

notes.value: Check the passport used to enter is also used to leave Indonesia. Keep visa approval, payment receipt, onward ticket, accommodation details and arrival-declaration QR confirmation accessible. The arrival declaration, visa, Bali tourist levy and customs declaration are distinct requirements or charges and should not be conflated. For travel with medication, verify each active ingredient with Indonesian authorities; a US prescription does not automatically authorize import.

approx_rate_note.notes: VOLATILE. Do not store a fixed USD/IDR rate. Retrieve a current rate at publication or display time, state the timestamp and distinguish market rates from card-network or ATM conversion rates.

cash_vs_card.value: Use a combination of Indonesian rupiah cash and cards. Cash remains useful for small vendors, markets, local transport and smaller businesses; card acceptance is more common at established hotels and larger restaurants. Confirm fees and acceptance with the specific merchant.

atm_availability.value: ATMs are available in major visitor areas but reliability, withdrawal limits, fees and machine security vary. Use bank-affiliated machines in secure locations and decline dynamic currency conversion when it offers a clearly unfavorable rate.

currency_import_export_limit.value: The US State Department reports a maximum of IDR 100000000 for currency on entry and exit and notes that currency at or above the declaration threshold must be declared. Customs says cash and/or payment instruments totaling IDR 100000000 or more must be declared. Do not treat the stated maximum as permission to evade a declaration requirement.
currency_import_export_limit.notes: Opened 2026-10-13. Primary customs page: https://ecd.beacukai.go.id/forms/bc22 . Customs page says declaration is required at IDR 100000000 or more; the State Department describes a maximum of IDR 100000000 on entry and exit. Preserve this wording difference and check current Indonesian rules before travel.

tipping_norm.value: Tipping is discretionary rather than universally mandatory. Check whether a service charge is already included; a small additional tip may be appropriate for good service. Norms vary by service, venue and local practice.

value.role: Major international hub for onward domestic or international connections.

main_international_airports.notes: The official immigration page identifies Ngurah Rai as an immigration checkpoint. Current routes and terminal arrangements require airline or airport verification.

flight_from_audience_origins.notes: Do not invent direct-flight availability, schedules, fares or journey durations. For LAX, SFO, SEA, JFK, EWR, ORD, DFW and IAH, compare date-specific itineraries to DPS using airline schedules and actual booking data. Most itineraries require at least one connection; routing varies by date, carrier and disruption. No live fare or timetable dataset was verified for this file.

intercity_rail.value: Bali has no intercity passenger rail network. Trains can be useful on Java, but reaching Bali from Java requires a road-and-ferry connection or a flight.

buses.value: Bali has public buses and shuttle services, but coverage and frequency do not make them a universal substitute for private transport. Check the specific route, stop and operating schedule before planning around a bus.

domestic_flights.value: Domestic flights connect Bali with major Indonesian destinations. Airlines, schedules, baggage allowances and change fees vary; check the operating airline's rules for the actual fare.

ride_sharing.value: Grab and Gojek operate in parts of Bali, with availability and pickup rules varying by location. Some tourist attractions, ports and locally regulated areas can complicate pickups. Confirm availability in the app and agree on a lawful pickup point.

car_rental_and_driving.value: Indonesia drives on the left. Foreign visitors should verify their license, applicable international driving permit and motorcycle-specific entitlement before driving. Scooter rental does not confer legal permission to ride. Insurance exclusions, road conditions, congestion and local enforcement are material risks. No current official blood-alcohol limit or detailed licensing rule was verified in this research pass.
car_rental_and_driving.notes: US State Department advisory opened 2026-10-13. Verify licensing and insurance directly before publication.

climate_by_season.value: Bali generally has a wetter period around November through March and a relatively drier period around April through October, but timing varies by year, altitude and locality. Rain can occur during the nominal dry season; monthly climate descriptions are not daily forecasts. Check BMKG's current regional seasonal forecast.
climate_by_season.notes: BMKG Bali's climatology service was available and showed seasonal bulletins; the page retrieved for this pass included an older 2025 forecast, not a verified forecast for the complete 2026-27 travel season. Do not present its 2025 dates as current.

safety_health._note: Health and safety claims require periodic review. The CDC Indonesia traveler page was opened 2026-10-13 and reported a Zika travel health notice dated 2026-08-07. Advice may change.

advisory_level.value: US Department of State: Level 2, Exercise Increased Caution for Indonesia. Advisory issued 2026-07-07. It cites natural disasters, unrest and terrorism; the advisory specifically says not to travel to Central Papua and Highland Papua. These restrictions are not a statement that Bali itself is under a blanket do-not-travel warning.
advisory_level.notes: Official US government advisory opened 2026-10-13; displayed issue date 2026-07-07. Review after 2026-10-20 because advisories can change. Check the page again before every trip.

main_risk.value: Road crashes, especially involving motorcycles; mosquito-borne illness; gastrointestinal illness; ocean currents and drowning; volcanic activity, earthquakes and other natural hazards; theft and scams; alcohol adulteration; and severe legal consequences for prohibited drugs. Risk varies substantially by activity and location.

vaccines.value: Consult a travel-health clinician at least a month before departure. CDC recommends routine vaccines be up to date and recommends hepatitis A for unvaccinated travelers aged one year or older and hepatitis B for unvaccinated travelers of all ages. Typhoid is recommended for most travelers. Rabies pre-exposure vaccination depends on exposure and access to prompt care. Japanese encephalitis vaccination depends on itinerary and duration. CDC reported Zika cases in returning travelers from Bali in a notice dated 2026-08-07; mosquito and sexual-transmission precautions are important, and pregnancy-related travel advice needs particular care.
vaccines.notes: Official CDC traveler page opened 2026-10-13. Its retrieved content identifies the Zika notice dated 2026-08-07 and vaccine guidance. Review after 2026-10-20 and again before publication. Recommendations depend on health history, route and duration.

tap_water_safe.value: Do not assume tap water is potable. Travelers generally use sealed bottled water or water treated by a reliable provider for drinking; ice and food hygiene require judgment. Avoid claiming that all water or ice in every establishment is unsafe or safe.

value.ambulance: 118 or 119; availability and dispatch arrangements can vary

emergency_numbers.notes: Numbers are commonly published for Indonesia but were not confirmed against a currently opened official emergency-services directory during this pass. Verify before publishing and include local hospital and insurer emergency contacts.

sim_esim.value: Travelers can consider an international eSIM, a local Indonesian SIM or roaming. Device compatibility, data allowance, ID registration and whether a foreign handset needs IMEI registration depend on the plan and circumstances. Confirm current tourist registration rules with the carrier and Indonesian authorities; do not state that every short-term visitor must register a foreign handset without verifying the applicable exemption.

coverage.value: Coverage is generally better in developed tourist areas than in remote, mountainous or offshore locations. Coverage on Nusa Penida, Nusa Lembongan, the Gilis and remote parts of Bali varies by carrier and terrain. Download offline maps and retain key bookings offline.

costs._note: No current price dataset was retrieved. Do not fill illustrative budget values with unsupported figures. All amounts must be dated, specify USD and IDR conversion basis, and state whether accommodation, transport, activities, meals and international flights are included.

dress_norms.value: Beachwear is appropriate at many beaches and pools but not generally suitable for temple visits or formal religious settings. At temples, follow posted rules and staff guidance, cover shoulders and knees as required, and use a sarong where requested. Dress expectations differ between ordinary public spaces and religious ceremonies.

plan.notes: This itinerary prioritizes geographic variety over minimizing hotel changes. North and East Bali involve substantial road travel; omit a region if a slower pace matters more. Boat travel and outdoor activities remain conditional on current weather, sea and access conditions.

assumptions.value: Fourteen calendar days, international arrival and departure at DPS, multiple road-based accommodation bases, and one Nusa-island leg. Gili Islands or Lombok are deliberately excluded to prevent an overly compressed route. All transfer times, ticket prices and attraction opening hours require date-specific verification.

value.name: Ubud and surrounding countryside
value.why: A strong first-time base for cultural attractions, food and access to inland landscapes.

value.name: Uluwatu Temple and the Bukit Peninsula
value.why: Clifftop scenery, coastal views and a different atmosphere from inland Bali.

value.name: Sanur
value.why: A more relaxed coastal base and practical point for Nusa-island boat connections.

value.name: Nusa Lembongan
value.why: A manageable island extension for visitors with enough time for an overnight stay and weather flexibility.

value.name: Nusa Penida
value.why: Dramatic coastal scenery and marine excursions, with substantial road and sea-condition caveats.

value.name: Munduk and North Bali
value.why: A useful alternative for cooler highland scenery, waterfalls and a less coast-focused itinerary.

value.name: Sidemen and East Bali
value.why: A slower countryside-oriented option for travelers willing to spend more time on road transfers.

value.name: Gili Islands or Lombok
value.why: A worthwhile extension for longer trips, provided the traveler can allow for separate transfers and weather-related disruption.

must_see_overall.notes: Editorial recommendations, not a definitive ranking. The best selection depends on trip length, mobility, interests, weather, budget and tolerance for transfers. Verify current access, fees, marine conditions and local rules before publication.

_open_questions._note: Material research gaps and unresolved claims. Do not silently treat these items as verified. Every consequential fact should be checked again immediately before publication and when rules change.

value.question: Confirm current ordinary-US-passport eligibility, tourist visa subtype, maximum stay, extension period, fee, processing time, passport condition and blank-page requirements on the official Indonesian eVisa and Immigration pages.
value.notes: The Ngurah Rai Immigration page was opened and lists the US for VOA, IDR 500000 and a 30-day initial stay. No separate authoritative processing-time commitment was established.

value.question: Confirm the exact current submission deadline, whether every international passenger including children requires an individual record, whether the same QR covers immigration, customs, health and quarantine declarations, and what exceptions apply.
value.notes: Official Immigration material says international passengers must use All Indonesia from 1 October 2025 and the form can be completed up to three days before arrival. The customs page states that from 1 September 2025, arrivals should use the integrated system. Confirm the current nationwide scope and dates.

value.question: Reopen the official Love Bali FAQ and confirm the IDR 150000 levy, who must pay, exemptions, payment channels and whether any rules have changed.
value.notes: Search result from the official Bali provincial Love Bali site states IDR 150000 per foreign tourist, paid once during the Indonesia trip before leaving the country, with specified exemptions. An attempt to open the page returned an internal error, so the details should be reopened and confirmed before marking as fully verified.

value.question: Verify active-ingredient-specific rules for common US prescription medicines, stimulants, ADHD medications, sedatives, opioids, cannabis-derived products, CBD and over-the-counter medicines. Confirm required letters, prescriptions, quantities and any advance authorization.
value.notes: The US advisory warns that cannabis, CBD and some prescription medicines, including certain ADHD medicines, may be illegal. The complete current Indonesian prohibited-substance list and medicine-specific import procedure were not verified.

value.question: Confirm current passenger duty-free allowances, customs declaration procedure, import restrictions for electronic cigarettes and liquids, and penalties for excess quantities.
value.notes: Official customs content was opened through search results. It says cash and/or payment instruments totaling IDR 100000000 or more must be declared and lists excisable goods among declaration categories. Detailed current allowances remain unverified.

value.question: Resolve the distinction between the US State Department's stated maximum of IDR 100000000 on entry and exit and Indonesian Customs' declaration threshold of IDR 100000000 or more.
value.notes: Preserve the exact wording from each source. Do not infer that a maximum and a declaration threshold are interchangeable.

value.topic: US travel advisory and health notices
value.question: Recheck the State Department advisory and CDC travel health notice before publishing safety, Zika, vaccine or pregnancy-related guidance.
value.notes: State Department advisory displayed Level 2 and issue date 2026-07-07. CDC page displayed a Zika notice dated 2026-08-07. Both are change-prone.

value.question: Confirm police, ambulance and fire numbers against current official Indonesian or Bali emergency-services information, including how English-speaking callers should request help and whether emergency numbers work from foreign SIMs.
value.notes: Commonly published numbers have been included only as provisional values. They were not verified against a current official emergency directory in this pass.

value.question: Verify the exact Indonesian licensing requirements for US visitors driving cars or motorcycles, the applicable international driving permit convention, motorcycle entitlement, helmet requirements, local enforcement and insurance consequences.
value.notes: The legal details and current blood-alcohol limit were not fully checked against Indonesian primary legal sources.

value.question: Confirm whether a tourist using a foreign handset and a local Indonesian SIM must register the IMEI, the duration-based exemptions and the official procedure.
value.notes: Do not conflate SIM-card identity registration with handset IMEI registration or assume all tourists face the same rule.

value.topic: Boat routes, operators and sea safety
value.question: Verify current official departure terminals, licensed operators, schedules, baggage allowances, check-in times, safety arrangements, cancellation policies and refund terms for Sanur-Nusa Penida, Sanur-Nusa Lembongan and Bali-Gili/Lombok routes.
value.notes: No current operator schedule or live sea-condition source was verified. Do not state exact crossing times or guaranteed departures.

value.question: Collect current airline schedule data for LAX, SFO, SEA, JFK, EWR, ORD, DFW and IAH to DPS; verify actual operating carriers, connections, layover requirements, total journey times, through-ticket protections and current fares.
value.notes: No live booking search or current fare data was obtained. Do not invent direct routes or publish a generic journey duration as a guaranteed result.

value.question: Retrieve a dated USD/IDR rate and representative current costs for accommodation, meals, drivers, domestic transport, activities and boat transfers. State inclusions and assumptions for every budget scenario.
value.notes: All budget values and exchange-rate values intentionally remain null.

value.question: Check current provincial tourist rules, enforcement procedures, fines, deportation provisions, temple restrictions and any changes affecting tourists.
value.notes: The national advisory is not a complete substitute for current Bali provincial law or official local guidance.

value.question: Verify practical Indonesian allergy phrases and current emergency-care contacts. Do not imply that translation cards guarantee avoidance of cross-contamination.
value.notes: The CDC source supports general food and water precautions, not venue-specific allergy-management guarantees.

value.question: Before publishing individual attractions, restaurants, hotels, yoga retreats, beach clubs or tour operators, verify that each still exists, its official booking page, opening hours, access restrictions, current pricing, and suitability for the stated traveler.
value.notes: Recommendations in this file are category-level editorial judgments. No venue-level live listings, ratings or prices were independently checked.
